item.title: Coco
item.description: Coco is an adorable puppy who’s still learning the basics. She’s very smart and eager to please, making her a great candidate for training.

item.title: Lola
item.description: Lola is a very affectionate dog who loves to be close to her humans. She’s perfect for someone who wants a lap dog and constant companion.

item.title: Pepper
item.description: Pepper is a small dog with a huge personality. She’s very intelligent and needs mental stimulation, making her perfect for someone who enjoys training and playing games.

item.title: Luna
item.description: Luna has made incredible progress since arriving at our shelter. She was very shy initially but has blossomed into a confident and loving companion. She’s been adopted by a wonderful family!

item.title: Penny
item.description: Penny is a tiny dog with a huge personality. She loves to be carried around and pampered, making her perfect for someone who wants a constant companion.
